title: Inventory every declared IFX gate and source authority before V4 porting
goal: Freeze the V3_ifx manifest graph, source hashes and per-gate V4 destination/gap matrix, and correct the parent program scope without changing executable guard bytes.
acceptanceCriteria: The C0 inventory reconciles all declared Stage gate IDs, 36 domain authorities, 11 rule files, 19 commands, four projections, eight bindings and the core policy/manifest hashes.
Each obligation has an explicit P10.1 V4 destination or a blocking/deferred governance classification; Plan04, Database, Quality and Historical Integrity are not omitted.
Formal Pre/Diff, source-hash checks, isolated IFX package test and unchanged V4 Package hash pass; no release, bundle or installation changes occur.
